verificationMethod: Each airport/operator passenger contact and airport-map page was independently opened and checked; application results were not used as the sole truth source.

sources.title: Contact Us | Heathrow
sources.evidence: Passenger contact page labels 0344 335 1801 as the Heathrow contact centre and separates specialist contacts.

sources.title: Airport maps | Heathrow
sources.evidence: Official page links the interactive map and terminal 2, 3, 4 and 5 maps separately from transport maps.

sources.title: Contact Us - JFK Airport
sources.evidence: Official page says general JFK airport questions should call +1 (718) 244-4444.

sources.title: JFK Airport Maps
sources.evidence: Official entry links an interactive map covering terminals, gates, AirTrain, amenities and pick-up areas.

sources.title: Paris Aéroport passenger contact
sources.evidence: Official passenger contact route; official passenger materials list 3950 domestically and +33 1 70 36 39 50 internationally.

sources.title: Terminal maps at Paris-CDG Airport
sources.evidence: Official passenger page covers CDG terminals 1, 2A-2G and 3.

sources.title: Schiphol | Contact us for questions and complaints
sources.evidence: Official page labels the center 24/7 and gives 0900 0141 domestically and +31 20 7940800 from abroad.

sources.title: Schiphol Map | Find your way around the airport
sources.evidence: Official passenger airport-map entry for facilities and wayfinding, not a parking-only or transport map.
